types.label: value.title
types.note: A project-related objective — the durable unit of long-range intent. Keyed `goal/<id>`. Its tasks are `task` facts nested under `task/<id>/…` whose keyEdges project a task —partOf→ goal edge, so the whole plan renders on the graph/canvas without the goal carrying an embedded list. Lifecycle: proposed → active → (done | blocked | dropped), reversible.

schema.title: string
schema.project: string? — a project fact key this goal advances, e.g. kb/proj_sol

types.label: value.title
types.note: A sub-unit of a goal, keyed `task/<goal>/<id>`. The key-encoded rule projects a task —partOf→ goal edge (ADR-0003/0016). Cross-task dependencies ride `value.dependsOn` (task keys); the cell's `next` tool resolves them to surface only actionable work. Lifecycle: todo → doing → (done | blocked | cancelled), reversible.

schema.title: string
schema.dependsOn: string[]? — task keys this task waits on (all must be done)
